lessons.correction: Continue developing your economy and technology while strengthening your ground army. Maintain your expansion and production.
lessons.mistake: Tempting to strengthen your ground army and increase production, economy, and expansion aggressively, but this can lead to engaging Siege Tanks head-on without proper tech or positioning, or over-expanding without sufficient army to defend.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if the opponent shows signs of air transitions or heavy pressure.
lessons.title: Avoid overextending against a heavy ground Terran
lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 240-360 game time, with a solid economy and expansion, and enemy intelligence indicating a Terran ground posture with heavy production and technology, possibly Marines and Reapers.
lessons.why: A strong economy and technology base will allow you to outproduce the Terran in the midgame. Ground army strength is important to defend against potential pressure.

lessons.correction: Focus on economy and expansion while maintaining a defensive posture. Continue developing your technology.
lessons.mistake: Tempting to strengthen ground army and increase production, economy, and expansion, but this can overcommit to army production early, slowing your economy, and neglect scouting for early pressure or all-ins.
lessons.recheck: Recheck as soon as more enemy information is available.
lessons.title: Avoid overcommitting to army when enemy is unknown
lessons.when: Early game, around 180-240 game time, with a heavy economy and expansion, and enemy intelligence uncertain with no clear combat units observed, but production and technology appear heavy.
lessons.why: A strong economy early will pay off later. Since the opponent's intentions are unclear, it's safe to focus on macro.

lessons.correction: Continue investing in technology while maintaining a defensive ground army. Be prepared for drops or harassment.
lessons.mistake: Tempting to continue investing in technology and increase economy and expansion, but this can neglect army production while teching, or over-expand if an imminent attack is sensed.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if the opponent shows signs of a timing attack or air transition.
lessons.title: Avoid neglecting army while teching against multi-pronged pressure
lessons.when: Midgame, around 420 game time, with a heavy economy and investing in technology, and enemy intelligence showing a Terran ground posture with Marines, Reapers, Hellions, and Medivacs, indicating potential multi-pronged pressure.
lessons.why: Technology will give you access to stronger units and upgrades. A defensive posture is needed to handle potential multi-pronged attacks.
